column1: # Machine-learning model files bundled in the app as assets. They are NOT stored in this repository:
# `./gradlew :app:fetchModels` (run automatically by every build) downloads each one, checks its
# SHA-256 and places it under app/models/assets/. A file that does not match is rejected.
# Columns, separated by TAB: asset path, download URL (pinned to a commit), SHA-256.
# Licenses and provenance: NOTICE.md and docs/ML.md.
